title: Double the silo loading rate
summary: If we increase the Loading_PerSecond at SL100, single-order loading time drops from ~33 min to ~17 min. Worth testing in the simulator.

changes.note: More buffer in front of the silo so peak arrivals don't queue at the gate.

changes.description: Spread truck arrivals over a 2-hour window instead of clustering at t=0.

expected_impact: Eliminates parking saturation under heavier loads.
risks: Requires physical space for additional parking spots — not modelled.
